description: Adds the execution DAG runtime, deterministic node context manifests, Snow CLI support, and a planning-convergence gate, with cross-platform context integrity fixes.
changelog:
**Enhancements:**
- feat(execution): add strict `execution.json` v1 planning, validation, conservative legacy normalization, stable plan hashing, conflict-aware ready-set fan-out, wait-any scheduling, NodeResult v1, and recoverable runtime state.
- feat(context): generate bounded, redacted, auditable node context manifests with direct dependency results; hook push, agent pull, channel context files, and inline execution consume the same claimed artifact.
- feat(platforms): add Snow CLI project skills, prompt commands, agents, session/user/sub-agent hooks, and session identity propagation; align Codex/channel/platform context handling with Trellis v0.6.11.
- feat(hub): preserve Hub subtasks v1 payload/hash while projecting display nodes from `execution.json` when no explicit `subtasks.json` override exists.

**Bug fixes:**
- fix(planning): finalize and validate the DAG only after blocking questions are resolved and planning artifacts converge; reuse an unchanged reviewed graph instead of regenerating it on every turn.
- fix(execution): harden orphan recovery, normalized scope conflicts, retry unblocking, successful-result evidence, lifecycle gates, final barriers, and dispatch metadata.
- fix(context): persist immutable context content as exact LF UTF-8 bytes on every OS so Windows does not invalidate the declared SHA-256 immediately after creation.
- fix(hub): include the failing upload URL in Hub upload diagnostics.

**Compatibility:**
- Existing tasks without `execution.json` continue through conservative serial normalization. Complex-task enforcement is snapshotted only into newly-created tasks when `require_for_complex_tasks` is enabled.
- `execution.dag.enabled: false` restores the legacy serial workflow without deleting reviewed plans.
notes: No `--migrate` required. Run `suncode update` after upgrading so workflow, hooks, agents, scripts, and the additive execution configuration section are refreshed. Bundled v0.6.12 execution adapters use shared-worktree context artifacts; a custom adapter selecting worktree or sandbox isolation must provide transport for `.suncode/.runtime/execution` artifacts. Review `execution.dag.require_for_complex_tasks` before enabling enforcement for newly-created complex tasks.
